title: The fire
body: The smoke was not a metaphor. A cabinet labelled TUESDAY catches. The sprinklers do not. The form on the desk does not burn. Recommended: do not proceed. — M.

choices.label: Go through the smoke. The form is the point.

outcome.text: Heat like a server room. On the other side of the fire: an office that is your office, and someone already sitting in your chair.

choices.label: Retreat. Take the stairs. The memo was right.

outcome.text: You leave with ash on your cuffs and a key that was in the work-order envelope. The map does not have a lock for it. Floor 12 will close behind you, for now.
